verdict.rationale: Groq is a hosted LLM inference API, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out (for example, data-retention or logging controls) is a fair axis for it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any such opt-out, privacy setting, or data-retention control. The cited docs cover inference, batch, service tiers, structured outputs, MCP and billing, none of which address this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
